extraction.Name: Ola Didier (Gilbert)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded October 13, 1918. The receipt for patent was signed by the allottee by Charles St. John.
extraction.Buyer: Ola and Frank Gilbert mortgaged the land to the Wewela State Bank for $1000, due February 4, 1921; on October 24, 1924, sheriff's certificate of sale was issued to the Wewela State Bank for $1000 on account of the mortgage; sheriff's deed to the Wewela State Bank was issued on December 13, 1928, showing total amount of $1726.49
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612714 issued; Northwest quarter section 34, township 95, north of range 75; receipt for patent signed April 18, 1918; mortgage executed February 4, 1920 by Ola and Frank Gilbert to Wewela State Bank for $1000 due February 4, 1921; sheriff's certificate of sale issued October 24, 1924; sheriff's deed issued December 13, 1928 for total amount of $1726.49
